completion:
# Building Structure

- Do you see any cracks in the walls of the building?
- Does the building tilt or lean in any way? 
- Are any parts of the exterior of the building unstable or in danger of falling?
- Are the windows of the building uneven?
- Do you feel like anything inside the building is crooked or tilted? 
- Is the floor of the building even? Is it cracked or damaged?
- Are there any parts of the exterior of the building missing?
- Are you able to open the doors of the building? Once opened, do they seem loose or unstable?
- Does the ceiling of the building show signs of leaks?
